summary: Illustrative example only. Bumps org.apache.poi:poi-ooxml from 5.0.0 to 5.4.0 in employee-service/pom.xml, the minimum version that remediates CVE-2025-31672 per its own advisory (affected: < 5.4.0). No other version in the dependency-management chain overrides this coordinate, so the explicit <version> bump is the correct, sufficient fix.

files_changed.change: Changed <version>5.0.0</version> to <version>5.4.0</version> for the org.apache.poi:poi-ooxml dependency.

residual_risk: This upgrade does not add structural validation of uploaded files beyond what the library itself now rejects — a defence-in-depth improvement to ExcelUploadImpl remains a separate, out-of-scope follow-up.
